title: Swarms of Tiny Robots Remove Microplastics From Soil and Water - Slashdot

content_html:
alternative_right shares a report from Phys.org: Scientists from the Czech Republic have created microscopic cleanup robots that successfully removed microplastics from both soil and aquatic environments in the lab. Details of their work are published in the journal npg Asia Materials. To build the robots, researchers started with microscopic MXene particles made of ultrathin, stacked layers. The material has a large surface area and surface chemistry that help it attract and hold plastic. They then coated the particles with magnetic nickel nanoparticles so rotating magnetic fields could drive the tiny robots.

Then came the testing phase. The team placed swarms of these microbots into water and soil samples contaminated with plastic. The externally generated magnetic fields made the robots spin and tumble through the liquid and squeeze through tiny water-filled gaps in the soil. "In soil environments, the microrobots can navigate through water-permeated soil microenvironments, actively disrupt microplastic entrapment within soil matrices, and extract them," the study authors commented in their paper. As they moved, their sticky surfaces collided with microplastics, binding to them and dragging them along. The researchers then used a magnet to pull the microrobots, along with their trapped plastic cargo, out of the samples.

They performed well. In water, they removed about 94% of test polystyrene particles and 89% of PET (polyethylene terephthalate) in around an hour. In the model soil, they removed about 81% of the polystyrene and 72% of PET. This outperformed the same MXene material used without magnetic motion, which relied on passive adsorption rather than actively moving through soil and water.

sentences.en: Details of their work are published in the journal npg Asia Materials.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作详情发表在《npg Asia Materials》杂志上。

sentences.zh: 为了建造机器人，研究人员从由超薄堆叠层制成的微观 MXene 颗粒开始。

sentences.en: The material has a large surface area and surface chemistry that help it attract and hold plastic.
sentences.zh: 该材料具有较大的表面积和表面化学性质，有助于吸引和固定塑料。

sentences.en: They then coated the particles with magnetic nickel nanoparticles so rotating magnetic fields could drive the tiny robots.
sentences.zh: 然后他们用磁性镍纳米颗粒涂覆颗粒，这样旋转磁场就可以驱动微型机器人。

sentences.en: Then came the testing phase.
sentences.zh: 然后是测试阶段。

sentences.en: The team placed swarms of these microbots into water and soil samples contaminated with plastic.
sentences.zh: 研究小组将这些微型机器人群放入被塑料污染的水和土壤样本中。

sentences.en: The externally generated magnetic fields made the robots spin and tumble through the liquid and squeeze through tiny water-filled gaps in the soil.
sentences.zh: 外部产生的磁场使机器人在液体中旋转和翻滚，并挤压土壤中充满水的微小间隙。

sentences.zh: 当它们移动时，它们的粘性表面与微塑料碰撞，将它们结合并拖拽它们。

sentences.en: The researchers then used a magnet to pull the microrobots, along with their trapped plastic cargo, out of the samples.
sentences.zh: 然后研究人员使用磁铁将微型机器人及其捕获的塑料货物从样本中拉出。

sentences.en: They performed well.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得很好。

sentences.en: In water, they removed about 94% of test polystyrene particles and 89% of PET (polyethylene terephthalate) in around an hour.
sentences.zh: 在水中，他们在大约一个小时内去除了约 94% 的测试聚苯乙烯颗粒和 89% 的 PET（聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯）。

sentences.en: In the model soil, they removed about 81% of the polystyrene and 72% of PET.
sentences.zh: 在模型土壤中，他们去除了约 81% 的聚苯乙烯和 72% 的 PET。

sentences.en: This outperformed the same MXene material used without magnetic motion, which relied on passive adsorption rather than actively moving through soil and water.
sentences.zh: 这优于没有磁运动的相同 MXene 材料，后者依赖于被动吸附，而不是主动穿过土壤和水。

content_html_zh: Alternative_right 分享了 Phys.org 的一份报告：捷克共和国的科学家发明了微型清理机器人，可以在实验室中成功清除土壤和水生环境中的微塑料。 他们的工作详情发表在《npg Asia Materials》杂志上。 为了建造机器人，研究人员从由超薄堆叠层制成的微观 MXene 颗粒开始。 该材料具有较大的表面积和表面化学性质，有助于吸引和固定塑料。 然后他们用磁性镍纳米颗粒涂覆颗粒，这样旋转磁场就可以驱动微型机器人。 然后是测试阶段。 研究小组将这些微型机器人群放入被塑料污染的水和土壤样本中。 外部产生的磁场使机器人在液体中旋转和翻滚，并挤压土壤中充满水的微小间隙。 研究作者在论文中评论道：“在土壤环境中，微型机器人可以在透水的土壤微环境中导航，主动破坏土壤基质中的微塑料截留，并将其提取出来。” 当它们移动时，它们的粘性表面与微塑料碰撞，将它们结合并拖拽它们。 然后研究人员使用磁铁将微型机器人及其捕获的塑料货物从样本中拉出。 他们表现得很好。 在水中，他们在大约一个小时内去除了约 94% 的测试聚苯乙烯颗粒和 89% 的 PET（聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯）。 在模型土壤中，他们去除了约 81% 的聚苯乙烯和 72% 的 PET。 这优于没有磁运动的相同 MXene 材料，后者依赖于被动吸附，而不是主动穿过土壤和水。
